messages:
elaine: Dropping pen-test + vuln scan artifacts for the ACME security/legal package. Putting checksums and shared links in the bucket. Need remediation owners and ETA by EOW to include in the customer packet.

mike_sec: Quick triage: 4 HIGH, 12 MED. Highs: telemetry endpoint auth bypass, outdated protobuf (RCE), permissive CORS on /api/stats, admin IPs leaked in logs. I can draft remediation steps once owners assigned.

anna_platform: I can own telemetry and CORS. Plan: canary config change tomorrow morning, full rollout Thu EOD.

sam_sre: Please confirm the artifacts + checksums. I will mirror to internal evidence bucket and timestamp. Need the Qualys XML unzipped for triage.

elaine: Uploaded: s3://rwinf-sales/audit/ACME/1934567991/pen-test-2026-03-18.pdf and s3://rwinf-sales/audit/ACME/1934567991/qualys-2026-03-17.zip. Checksums (sha256): pen-test-2026-03-18.pdf 3b1e9f8a6c3d4a2f5f9b7c8d7e6a5b4c3d2e1f0a9b8c7d6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8; qualys-2026-03-17.zip d4c3b2a190f8e7d6c5b4a3928172635443322110ffeeddccbbaa998877665544.

mike_sec: Before sending to the customer we need a redacted pen-test (remove internal IPs, service account ARNs, hostnames). Who can redact?

anna_platform: I will scrub logs and produce a redacted PDF and manifest. ETA today 17:00 PT.

audit-bot: Automated scan summary: High 4, Med 12, Low 29. Report ID RB-ACME-2026-03-18.

sam_sre: Mirror complete. Internal mirror: s3://rwinf-internal/audit_mirror/ACME/1934567991/sha256.txt. Checksums verified.

mike_sec: After redaction, I'll review. For the customer cover note include this remediation timeline: Telemetry auth fix owner @anna_platform patch+canary 2026-03-19 12:00 PT full rollout 2026-03-19 23:00 PT; Protobuf update owner @dev-team PR+tests by 2026-03-20 deploy 2026-03-22; CORS tighten owner @anna_platform deploy 2026-03-19 14:00 PT; Log redaction owner @sam_sre mask+replay test by 2026-03-20.

elaine: I'll add timeline to the cover note. Any blockers to sending after redaction and signoff?

sam_sre: Customer will want proof of fixes (PR diffs, CI run IDs, deploy job IDs). I'll collect CI artifacts post-deploy and attach evidence bundle.

anna_platform: Redacted PDF uploaded: s3://rwinf-sales/audit/ACME/1934567991/pen-test-2026-03-18-redacted.pdf. Manifest uploaded: pen-test-redaction-manifest.txt.

mike_sec: Reviewing. Please remove debug snippet in Appendix B (stack traces still show internal hostnames) and replace admin IP list with a placeholder.

anna_platform: Will update redaction and re-upload in 15 minutes.

mike_sec: Signed off after appendix change and IP placeholder swap. :thumbsup: Include remediation timeline and PR links in the packet.

elaine: Sending to ACME security + legal now with a 1-week feedback window, cc solutions-eng. Outreach sent 2026-03-19 20:00 UTC.

sam_sre: Copy received. I will attach PR/CI evidence to this thread as items land.

elaine: Thanks everyone 1 cross-functional turnaround. Updated the sales opp with package timestamp and next customer call.
